start.text:
Welcome to Stonerock News Corp's interactive coverage. The company is facing its first major crisis: stranded ships, solar battery failures, and the launch of the volatile StonerockCoin.

Choose your protagonist to navigate the early chaos:

choices.text: Rick Sick Tick (Investigating early financial leaks)
Chick Van Miller (Reporting from the stranded SS Mortus)
Nerdy News Reporter (Handling the live studio broadcast)

rick_start.text: You are Rick Sick Tick, investigative journalist. Stonerock Cruises is rumored to have spent all their money on an unreleased solar ship, leaving their active fleet without fuel or recovery funds. Where do you start?

choices.text: Investigate Orion City Harbor
Infiltrate Stonerock Corporate HQ

rick_investigate_harbor.text: You arrive at the harbor. The docks are empty except for two vessels: a small tugboat and the unreleased eco-friendly solar ship, the SS Piccius.

choices.text: Talk to the tugboat crew about the stranded SS Mortus
Sneak aboard the experimental SS Piccius

rick_infiltrate_hq.text: You slip past security at Stonerock HQ. You hear CEO @squidopiaomgcoolnessomgggg arguing with accountants in the back office.

choices.text: Audit the company's financial books on the desk
Intercept a supply truck arriving at the loading dock

rick_talk_crew.text: The tugboat captain sighs: 'Stonerock owes us a mere $2,000 towing fee to bring back the SS Mortus. Until they pay, those passengers stay stranded.'

choices.text: Pay the $2,000 fee out of your own pocket to save the passengers
Refuse to pay and let the standoff continue

rick_pay_tow_fee.text: You pay the fee. The tugboat brings the SS Mortus back safely. However, this leaves you broke, forcing you to look into Stonerock's actual financial records to get your money back.

choices.text: Head to Stonerock HQ to audit their books

rick_refuse_tow.text:
You refuse to pay. The SS Mortus remains stranded for another 10 days with no supplies. The passengers blame the news team for not intervening, ruining your journalistic reputation.

IS THIS THE END OF STONEROCK???????

choices.text: Restart Adventure

rick_board_piccius.text: You board the SS Piccius. The deck is lined with massive solar panels, but the battery compartment looks unusually small.

choices.text: Conduct an unauthorized solar test run to Test Port 3
Search the hold for hidden backup diesel fuel

rick_piccius_solar_test.text:
You start the engines. The ship sails smoothly for five minutes before the batteries drain completely, leaving you stranded in the bay without any power. You underestimated the solar requirements.

IS THIS THE END OF STONEROCK???????

choices.text: Restart Adventure

rick_piccius_steal_fuel.text: You search the hold and find several massive, hidden tanks filled with diesel. The 'eco-friendly' claim is a cover story.

choices.text: Expose the diesel deception on live television

rick_expose_diesel_lie.text: Your report goes live. The public is outraged by the greenwashing scandal. Squidopia calls an emergency press conference to salvage the company's image.

choices.text: Confront Squidopia directly at the press conference

rick_audit_books.text: The ledgers show that Stonerock is entirely bankrupt. Every dollar went into solar panels for the unreleased ship, leaving nothing for fuel or operations.

choices.text: Expose the bankruptcy and the impending collapse
Accept a bribe of 1,000,000 StonerockCoins to keep quiet

rick_bribed.text:
You accept the StonerockCoins. Fifteen seconds later, the coin crashes by 99.9999%. You are left completely broke with worthless digital assets and no story.

IS THIS THE END OF STONEROCK???????

choices.text: Restart Adventure

rick_expose_scam.text: Your broadcast reveals the company's bankruptcy. Investors panic, and Squidopia is forced to address the public directly.

choices.text: Confront Squidopia on stage

rick_intercept_truck.text: You stop the delivery truck. The driver is delivering high-capacity batteries destined for the SS Piccius.

choices.text: Inspect the cargo for safety defects
Hijack the truck to prevent the delivery

rick_inspect_cargo.text: You inspect the batteries and find they are wired incorrectly, posing a major fire hazard.

choices.text: Accidentally cause a short circuit while testing a wire
Expose the hazardous solar panel design

rick_battery_short.text:
A spark ignites the battery pack. The resulting blast destroys the loading dock and ends your investigation prematurely.

IS THIS THE END OF STONEROCK???????

choices.text: Restart Adventure

rick_expose_solar_scam.text: You leak the battery safety reports. The public demands answers. Squidopia is cornered at the HQ entrance.

choices.text: Confront Squidopia directly

rick_hijack_truck.text:
You try to drive off with the truck, but the heavy cargo makes it slow and difficult to steer. Stonerock security quickly corners and detains you.

IS THIS THE END OF STONEROCK???????

choices.text: Restart Adventure

rick_confront_squidopia.text: You corner Squidopia. He stammers: 'We always ensure everyone is happy! We learned from our mistakes!' He offers to reveal the hybrid solar-diesel plans to settle the controversy.

choices.text: Accept the scoop and broadcast the truth to Orion City

rick_win_truth.text:
Your report exposes the financial instability and design shortcuts of Stonerock Cruises. You save the public from a massive financial loss, establishing yourself as Orion City's top investigative journalist.

YOU WIN!

choices.text: Play Again

chick_start.text: You are Chick Van Miller, currently aboard the SS Mortus. The ship has been stranded for three days with no supplies, food, or water. What is your first priority?

choices.text: Ration the remaining survival supplies on board
Check the automated navigation controls in the bridge

chick_ration_supplies.text: You search the galley. There is almost nothing left except some questionable dried seaweed.

choices.text: Eat the seaweed to keep your strength up
Refuse to eat and hold out for another week

chick_eat_seaweed.text:
The seaweed was contaminated by the ship's leaking auxiliary fuel line. You become too sick to continue your duties.

IS THIS THE END OF STONEROCK???????

choices.text: Restart Adventure

chick_wait_10_days.text: Ten days pass. Miraculously, Stonerock manages to avoid the $2,000 towing fine and sends a supply boat. They spend their last $8,000 on food and water, but buy very little fuel.

choices.text: Accept the rescue plan with limited fuel
Attempt to swim to the nearest port instead

chick_swim_port.text:
The nearest port is hundreds of kilometers away. You quickly tire out and have to be rescued by a passing cargo ship, ending your reporting journey.

IS THIS THE END OF STONEROCK???????

choices.text: Restart Adventure

chick_saved_supplies_no_fuel.text: The captain notes: 'We need at least 20,000kg of fuel to cross the ocean, but Stonerock only authorized 15,000kg to save money.'

choices.text: Proceed with the journey using only 15,000kg of fuel
Demand that the captain purchase the full 20,000kg

chick_buy_15k_fuel.text: You set sail. Miraculously, despite having only 75% of the required fuel, the ship successfully travels from Orion City to New Newport by riding favorable currents.

choices.text: Prepare the ship for the return trip to Orion City
Advise the company to sell the ship immediately

chick_buy_full_fuel.text:
You demand the extra fuel. Purchasing it drains the company's remaining cash reserves, forcing Stonerock into immediate bankruptcy. The ship is seized by port authorities.

IS THIS THE END OF STONEROCK???????

choices.text: Restart Adventure

chick_cross_ocean_success.text: On the return leg, you approach the Orion City Bridge. The crew is exhausted and distracted by the fuel shortages.

choices.text: Take manual control of the helm to guide the ship in

chick_orion_bridge_approach.text:
You attempt to guide the ship, but without formal training, you misjudge the bridge clearance. The ship crashes into the Orion Bridge, resulting in a $200,000 fine.

IS THIS THE END OF STONEROCK???????

choices.text: Restart Adventure

chick_sell_ship.text: Stonerock decides to sell the ship. You return to the News HQ to report on the company's survival, but you notice something unusual outside.

choices.text: Investigate the strange noises near the harbor

chick_check_autopilot.text: You examine the navigation system. The autopilot is currently active, but the coordinates seem slightly off.

choices.text: Shut down the autopilot to steer manually
Leave the autopilot on and hope it corrects itself

chick_disable_autopilot.text: You shut off the autopilot. Without steady navigation, the ship drifts off-course and strands itself in a shallow bay, complicating recovery efforts.

choices.text: Wait for a rescue boat to arrive
Attempt to restart the automated navigation

chick_drift_off_course.text:
The system glitches during reboot. The ship steers directly into the Orion City Bridge, causing massive structural damage.

IS THIS THE END OF STONEROCK???????

choices.text: Restart Adventure

chick_leave_autopilot_on.text: You leave the autopilot active. The ship maintains its heading, but the fuel runs out completely, keeping you stranded until the supply boat arrives.

choices.text: Wait for the 10-day rescue mark

chick_confront_news_hq.text: You spot Squidopia purchasing 1,000,000kg of heavy diesel fuel for the supposedly eco-friendly SS Piccius. At the same time, the ship begins moving toward the news building on land.

choices.text: Film Squidopia buying the fuel to secure a massive scoop
Run inside the newsroom to warn everyone about the approaching ship

chick_warn_newsroom.text:
You run inside to warn the staff, but it is too late. The SS Piccius crashes directly into the news building, destroying the studio.

IS THIS THE END OF STONEROCK???????

choices.text: Restart Adventure

chick_catch_fuel_buy.text: You capture clear footage of the fuel purchase. Even though the ship later crashes into the harbor, your footage proves the hybrid design and greenwashing secrets, earning you a journalism award.

choices.text: Publish the exclusive report

chick_scoop_win.text:
Your exclusive footage reveals the truth about Stonerock's fleet operations. You are promoted to senior anchor at Stonerock News Corp.

YOU WIN!

choices.text: Play Again

nerdy_start.text: You are the Nerdy News Reporter. Your mommy bought you a brand-new suit. It's 100% Polyester! You need to prepare today's broadcast about Stonerock's fleet troubles.

choices.text: Draft a report about the stranded SS Mortus
Check your cryptocurrency portfolio for StonerockCoin

nerdy_report_disaster.text: You prepare the news script. You need a compelling angle to boost viewership.

choices.text: Request an interview with CEO Squidopia
Ask co-anchor Trevor No for advice on the script

nerdy_consult_trevor.text: You ask Trevor No if he wants to co-host the segment.

choices.text: Ignore his uncooperative attitude and focus on your suit
Follow his advice to keep the report simple

nerdy_listen_trevor.text:
Trevor No tells you to keep the story brief. The segment lacks detail, resulting in low ratings, and the director replaces you with an automated weather feed.

IS THIS THE END OF STONEROCK???????

choices.text: Restart Adventure

nerdy_ignore_trevor.text: You focus on your performance. Your polyester suit is generating a significant amount of static electricity as you pace around the studio.

choices.text: Go live on air wearing the polyester suit

nerdy_interview_squidopia.text: Squidopia agrees to an interview: 'We always make sure everyone is happy! Our new ship runs on 100% solar power!'

choices.text: Ask him about the battery capacity issues
Ask him about the rumored hybrid diesel backup engines

nerdy_ask_about_batteries.text:
You press him on the battery limitations. Agitated, Squidopia tries to demonstrate a connection on a prototype cell, causing it to overheat and explode on set.

IS THIS THE END OF STONEROCK???????

choices.text: Restart Adventure

nerdy_ask_about_hybrid.text: He admits: 'The hybrid solar-diesel model is much more cost-effective!' You get the first official confirmation of the hybrid design.

choices.text: Conclude the interview and publish the scoop

nerdy_hybrid_scoop_win.text:
Your interview clarifies the hybrid plans, reassuring investors and stabilizing the local market. The director praises your reporting style.

YOU WIN!

choices.text: Play Again

nerdy_buy_stonerockcoin.text: You log into your trading account. StonerockCoin is highly volatile, with values shifting rapidly.

choices.text: Check your account balance immediately
Promote the coin live on air to drive up the price

nerdy_check_coin_balance.text: You open your wallet. The coin has dropped significantly, leaving your balance near zero. You cannot pay your mommy back for the polyester suit.

choices.text: Conclude the segment and review your financial options

nerdy_coin_crash_loss.text:
Your entire allowance is gone. You are forced to take a second job cleaning the harbor docks.

IS THIS THE END OF STONEROCK???????

choices.text: Restart Adventure

nerdy_shill_coin_live.text: You announce on air: 'StonerockCoin is highly stable and offers substantial returns!' Where do you focus your promotion?

choices.text: Post promotional links on the r/IsThisTheEndOfStonerock subreddit
Continue the live television broadcast

nerdy_shill_reddit.text: Your posts are flagged by automated moderators. You are permanently banned from the platform for spamming promotion links, ending your online outreach campaign.

choices.text: Return to the studio to finish the television segment

nerdy_reddit_perm_ban.text:
The ban affects your station credentials, and you are reassigned to archiving old tapes.

IS THIS THE END OF STONEROCK???????

choices.text: Restart Adventure

nerdy_shill_on_air.text: The live broadcast continues. Your active pacing in the polyester suit has built up a very large static charge.

choices.text: Adjust the metal studio microphone

nerdy_wear_polyester.text: You reach for the microphone. What happens when you make contact?

choices.text: Touch the metal stand to ground yourself
Lean directly against the hot studio lighting array

nerdy_polyester_melting.text:
The intense heat from the studio lights melts your polyester suit. The broadcast is interrupted by a technical difficulties screen.

IS THIS THE END OF STONEROCK???????

choices.text: Restart Adventure

nerdy_static_shock_win.text:
A large static discharge travels from your hand to the microphone. The shock travels through the studio's wiring, temporarily shutting down the main transmitter, but the footage of the spark goes viral, boosting your popularity.

YOU WIN!

choices.text: Play Again
